title: Trust Responsive Runtime Authorization for Agentic AI with Empirical Characterization of Policy Behavior and Parameter Sensitivity
abstract: arXiv:2611.06996v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The policy that converts runtime estimates of an autonomous agent's condition into operational authority is rarely specified or measured. We empirically characterize the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score (ARS), a weighted combination of runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk, onto discrete authorization levels through an asymmetric rule: escalation requires consecutive observations above a band edge plus a margin, while a sharp drop in readiness restricts authority at once. On one matched set of 100 Monte Carlo traces, we compare TRAP with static, trust-only, risk-only, and symmetric policies. translated_title: 面向智能体AI的信任响应式运行时授权——策略行为与参数敏感性的实证刻画
translated_abstract: arXiv:2611.06996v1 公告类型：新 摘要：将自主智能体运行时状态评估转化为操作权限的策略很少被明确规定或测量。我们对信任响应式授权策略（TRAP）进行了实证刻画，该策略通过一条非对称规则，将授权就绪分数（ARS）——即运行时信任、操作稳定性与情境风险的加权组合——映射到离散的授权级别上：权限提升需要连续多次观测值高于区间边界并附加一个余量，而就绪度的急剧下降则会立即限制权限。在一组匹配的100条蒙特卡洛轨迹上，我们将TRAP与静态策略、仅信任策略、仅风险策略以及对称策略进行比较。在突发退化情形下，TRAP在退化发生时即限制权限，并在恢复后比对应对称策略更快地重新提升权限，在自适应策略中表现出最高且（描述性地）方差最小的稳定性，尽管其恢复后的权限提升中更多发生在所选阈值的下方……
tldr: 该论文提出并实证刻画了信任响应式授权策略（TRAP），通过非对称规则将信任、稳定性与风险综合而成的授权就绪分数映射为运行时授权级别，实验表明其在突发退化时能即时限制权限、恢复后更快重新授权，并在各自适应策略中具有最高的稳定性。
en_tdlr: This paper empirically characterizes the Trust Responsive Authorization Policy (TRAP), which maps an Authorization Readiness Score combining runtime trust, operational stability, and contextual risk onto discrete authorization levels via an asymmetric rule, showing that it restricts authority immediately upon abrupt degradation, re-escalates faster after recovery, and achieves the highest stability among adaptive policies.
